audit.whatIsWrong: win[4] and phases[4].side give Level 6 to 'Skill' while whys[4], spikes[0].text and mid all call it Akali's cleanest kill window; win[6] and phases[6].side give 2+ items to Akali while whys[6], spikes[3].text and late all say Sejuani takes over there.
audit.why: Perfect Execution's recast executes on missing health, which ignores the armour and Frost stacking that is Sejuani's whole defence — that is a clear Akali level. Conversely Glacial Prison is a 1300-range stun on 120s and she itemises armour, so at two items a single-target burst cannot finish her. Leaving the chart as-is tells a player to hesitate at their strongest timing and to force a fight at their weakest.
audit.corrected: Level 6 flipped to Akali (7/10), 2+ items flipped to Sejuani (4/10), in win[] and phases[].side, with matching whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text, whys[5] and wants.foe[0] all say Sejuani needs '4 Frost stacks' before Permafrost.
audit.why: The number four appears nowhere in Riot's text. Permafrost 'freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks', and the stacks are applied by Winter's Wrath, which is a 9/8/7/6/5s two-swing ability. Counting to a number the game never shows you is the wrong cue; the cue is how many Winter's Wrath arcs have landed on you, and that is on a cooldown you can actually track.
audit.corrected: All references now say the Frost gauge filled by Winter's Wrath arcs, with the 9s rank-1 cooldown, instead of a stack count.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions are absent: Frost Armor's slow immunity against Five Point Strike, Twilight Shroud's unselectability against a targeted Permafrost (the entry says only 'breaks line of sight'), and Fury of the North's shatter on a stunned target.
audit.why: Riot's Fury of the North text gives Frost Armor 'Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows' — so the slow on Five Point Strike, the tool the entry tells you to poke with, does literally nothing until she has been kept in combat long enough for the armour to lapse. Riot's Twilight Shroud text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks': Permafrost is a targeted 560-range stun, so inside the smoke it cannot be cast at all — a harder guarantee than breaking line of sight, and the mirror entry states it the same way. And the passive lets her 'damage a stunned enemy to shatter it, dealing massive magic damage', which is why eating one Permafrost is not a normal trade.
audit.corrected: Slow immunity stated in whys[1] and early; Shroud unselectability stated in whys[3], wants.you[2] and mid; the shatter stated in spikes[1].text and early.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns are given, though the entry's whole plan is 'punish her engage'.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s and it is her only gap-closer; a missed one is an eighteen-second window at rank 1. Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 and Glacial Prison 120s. Those three numbers convert every vague 'punish her' into a schedule.
audit.corrected: 18s Arctic Assault, 20s Shroud, 120s Glacial Prison written into early, mid, late and the phase whys.

edits.before: She has no poke whatsoever — last-hit at Five Point Strike (Q) range and don't burn E, because her only opener is walking up with Arctic Assault (Q).
edits.after: She has no poke — last-hit at Five Point Strike range and hold E, because her only opener is Arctic Assault and it is down 18 seconds if she misses.

edits.before: Her passive Frost just stacks on contact and she out-stats you on base HP/armor — stay even, you can't burst a tank this early and she can't catch you.
edits.after: Frost Armor gives her resistances and immunity to slows, so your Q slow does nothing until you keep her in combat — stay even, neither of you finishes this early.

edits.before: Twilight Shroud (W) breaks line of sight on her Arctic Assault (Q) engage, but she's too tanky to actually kill — neutral, just reset bad trades.
edits.after: Inside Twilight Shroud you cannot be selected, so Permafrost cannot be cast on you at all — she is still too tanky to kill, so use it to reset, not to win.

edits.before: Rocketbelt/Lich Bane burst plus Shroud lets you all-in before she stacks 4 Frost and detonates Permafrost (E) — force the kill while she's one item.
edits.after: First-item burst plus Shroud lets you all-in before Winter's Wrath fills the Frost gauge for Permafrost (E) — force the kill while she is still one item.

edits.before: Sunfire/Frozen Heart plus her long-range Glacial Prison (R) AoE stun make her unkillable by single-target burst — she owns the late game and teamfights.
edits.after: Stacked armour plus a 1300-range Glacial Prison (R) stun makes her unkillable by single-target burst — she owns the late game and every teamfight in it.

edits.before: Rocketbelt or Lich Bane gives you the burst to all-in before she hits 4 Frost stacks and detonates Permafrost (E) — kill her on the engage, not after the stun lands.
edits.after: Your first item lets you all-in before Winter's Wrath fills the Frost gauge for Permafrost (E) — kill on the engage, because her passive shatters a stunned target for huge damage.

edits.after: Hold Twilight Shroud (W) for her step-up — inside it you are unselectable, so Permafrost cannot be cast on you at all

edits.after: Fill the Frost gauge with both Winter's Wrath arcs, then Permafrost (E) you out of your combo and shatter you

edits.before: Sejuani has no poke at all — her passive Frost just builds stacks on contact, and her only early threat is walking up with Arctic Assault (Q) to start an all-in. The danger is letting her reach 4 Frost stacks and detonating Permafrost (E) for a stun while she out-stats you on base HP and armor. You have only Five Point Strike (Q) at Level 1 with no Shroud yet, so farm at the tip of your Q and refuse to auto-trade into her tankier base. The good news: she has zero kill pressure on you this early, so survive even and don't get greedy for a trade you can't finish through her durability.
edits.after: Sejuani has no poke — Winter's Wrath is a 600-range melee swing, and her only opener is charging in with Arctic Assault, an 18-second cooldown at rank 1. Miss it and she has nothing for eighteen seconds — that is your window. The danger is Winter's Wrath filling your Frost gauge so Permafrost stuns you, because Fury of the North then shatters a stunned target for massive damage. Frost Armor also grants immunity to slows, so the slow on Five Point Strike buys you nothing until you have kept her in combat. You have only Q at level 1 and no Shroud, so farm at the tip of it and refuse to auto-trade into her base stats.

edits.before: Once Twilight Shroud (W) is online you can finally dictate — use it to break line of sight when she dashes in with Arctic Assault (Q), denying her the follow-up Frost stacks she needs to land Permafrost (E). At 6 your ult is the swing: E-flip onto her, dash through with Perfect Execution, then the second cast executes on her missing health before she can sit on you with a stun. This is your real window — burst her low while she's still a one-item tank, not after she's stacked armor.
edits.after: Once Twilight Shroud is online you dictate — it is 20 seconds at rank 1 and while you are inside it you cannot be selected by spells, so Permafrost, a targeted 560-range stun, cannot be cast on you at all. Step into the smoke as she charges Arctic Assault and her 18-second engage buys her nothing. At 6 your ult is the swing: E-flip onto her, dash through with Perfect Execution, then the recast executes on missing health, which ignores the armour she is buying. This is your window — burst her while she is one item, not after.

edits.before: This is where she takes over, and you have to accept it. A two-item Sejuani with Sunfire and Frozen Heart is too durable for your single-target magic burst to kill, and Glacial Prison (R) is a long-range AoE stun that locks you out of your whole combo in any teamfight — followed by Permafrost to chain it. Don't try to 1v1 a fed tank: use Shroud and your mobility to dodge her R bola, then dash past her to the carry. Win the game off your Level 6-to-first-item lead before her armor and chain-CC make you irrelevant.
edits.after: This is where she takes over, and you have to accept it. Two items of armour is too durable for single-target magic burst, and Glacial Prison reaches 1300 to stun you out of your whole combo in any teamfight, with Permafrost chaining behind it. Don't 1v1 a fed tank: hold Shroud for the bola, and if she throws it and misses she has 120 seconds of nothing — dash past her to the carry in that window. Win the game off your level 6-to-first-item lead before her armour and chain-CC make you irrelevant.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sejuani's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Perfect Execution's recast executes on missing health, which beats her armour stack. Glacial Prison is 120s — punish the miss.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Sejuani carry threat 5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items of armour plus a 1300-range stun outlast single-target burst — close the game out before her teamfights decide it.

notes: Sejuani's Glacial Prison carries a derived revealsStealth flag in the kit file, but Riot's own description says only that it stuns the first champion hit and slows others in the ice storm. I did not assert either way whether it can hit Akali inside Twilight Shroud — the mirror entry left the same question open, and the two pages now agree in saying nothing about it.
